notes.title: GAT RAT Demo out now!
notes.notes:
A rat with a massive arsenal of guns and weapons. Cook up your favorite combination of gats, spells, and perks to casually annihilate your enemies throughout the realms.

Check out the steam page here to download the free demo:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3661740/GAT_RAT/

notes.title: WEALTH UPDATE
notes.notes: Defeating enemies now gives triple the amount of coins as before. Enemies that dropped 1 coin upon death now drop 3, and enemies that dropped 2 coins now drop 6.
